topic: Handling phantom facility data in reports
summary_markdown: A discussion arose regarding 'phantom' facilities—those that no longer exist but are still generating session counts (Total Traffic) on the dashboard. Although these facilities do not appear in reports or campaigns, someone suggested removing them from the aggregate data set. [me] confirmed this action would be taken.
decisions: Phantom facility data will be removed from the aggregate calculation.
action_items: [me] to remove phantom facility data from the aggregate.
